accepted_observations: ObservedEvidence, InferredHypothesis, RetrievalPrior, NegativeResult and UnknownEvidence are distinct concrete record types with type-fixed non-authoritative classifications.
payloads are stored as canonical JSON text so mutating a decoded payload cannot mutate record identity.
provenance is bound by a lowercase sha256 digest and any admitted provenance replacement changes record identity.
hypotheses require explicit support references; retrieval priors require a query digest; negative results require attempt and falsifier references; UNKNOWN requires an explicit reason.
classification is a ClassVar fixed by concrete type and cannot be altered through dataclasses.replace as if it were an admitted field.
noncanonical JSON, NaN payloads, mutable causal-ref lists and duplicate causal refs fail closed.

Build the next smallest Stage-3 substrate that consumes these typed records without collapsing observation, inference, retrieval prior, negative result or UNKNOWN semantics; prefer a deterministic bounded context/retrieval selection contract before Method Memory persistence or GRID/GWT integration.
